title: 第一卷 第8章 想摘桃子？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老村长闫老革去喊人领取药物，闫耀宗便拉着汽车内胎，向着村委会走去。

“抱抱！”

闫耀宗刚把汽车内胎上边的东西，抬进一楼办公室，就看到傻婆娘从楼梯口跑下来，张开双臂，扑向自己。

闫耀宗连忙将手里油布包裹着的一罐酱油放在地上，展开双臂，将傻婆娘抱在怀里，笑道：“一个人待在这里，害不害怕？”

傻婆娘缩在闫耀宗怀里，昂着下巴，眨巴着大眼睛，憨憨一笑，“不怕不怕，坏人来了，媳妇打他！”

“傻丫头！”闫耀宗抬手捏了捏傻婆娘的鼻尖，道：“咱们先把东西抬楼上去，等下乡亲们要过来领东西！”

“嗯嗯嗯！”傻婆娘的脑袋，就如果小鸡啄米般点着。

傻婆娘虽然脑子转得不快，却也不是什么都不懂。

要不然，前世她也不可能背着自己，一步步地走到县医院。

俩人乐呵呵的将油盐酱醋、大米等等，搬到二楼小房间。

没一会儿，老村长闫老革就来到村委会。

瞧着被踹破的门锁，闫老革骂骂咧咧的朝着楼上喊道，“闫耀宗，你特娘的给老子滚下来！”

“来了来了！”

闫耀宗嬉皮笑脸地跑下楼。

“你个小兔崽子，别给老子嬉皮笑脸的。这次看在你把药品运回来的份上，老子不跟你计较，要是还有下次，肯定打断你两条腿。”闫老革警告道。

“叔，抽烟抽烟！”

闫耀宗嘿笑着掏出两包香烟，一包塞进闫老革的裤袋里，旋即才

闫老革笑骂了一句，也没有拒绝。

就在俩人聊着天的时候，乡亲们陆陆续续赶到村委会。

乡亲们打量着站在闫老革身边的闫耀宗。

以往的闫耀宗，就跟闷葫芦似的。

可现在，闫耀宗脸上洋溢着自信笑容，跟老村长聊着天。

“耀宗！”

闫振东穿着蓑衣，跑进办公室，第一时间走到闫耀宗身边。

等了七八分钟，老村长见人来得差不多，便开口道，“乡亲们，这次喊你们过来，主要是给你们分配一些药……这些药，是耀宗跟振东从卫生站拉回来的。所以，你们要

“耀宗的情况，你们也是知道的。所以，我决定把村委会二楼的小房间，暂时借给耀宗居住。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The old village chief Yan Laoge went to ask people to collect medicines, and Yan Yaozong pulled the inner tube of the car and walked towards the village committee.

"Hug!"

As soon as Yan Yaozong carried the things on the car inner tube into the office on the first floor, he saw the stupid woman running down the stairs, opening her arms and throwing herself at him.

Yan Yaozong quickly put the jar of soy sauce wrapped in oilcloth on the ground, spread out his arms, hugged the silly woman in his arms, and said with a smile: "Are you scared to stay here alone?"

The silly woman huddled in Yan Yaozong's arms, raised her chin, blinked her big eyes, and smiled innocently, "Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, the bad guy is here, my wife will beat him!"

"Silly girl!" Yan Yaozong raised his hand and pinched the tip of the silly woman's nose, and said, "Let's carry the things upstairs first, and wait until the villagers come to collect the things!"

"Yeah, yeah, yeah!" The silly woman's head was nodding like a chicken pecking at rice.

Although the silly woman's brain doesn't work very fast, she doesn't understand everything.

Otherwise, she would not have been able to carry herself step by step to the county hospital in her previous life.

The two happily moved the oil, salt, sauce, vinegar, rice, etc. to the small room on the second floor.

After a while, the old village chief Yan Laoge came to the village committee.

Looking at the kicked-in door lock, Yan Laoge cursed and shouted upstairs, "Yan Yaozong, get the hell out of here!"

"Coming, coming!"

Yan Yaozong ran downstairs with a playful smile.

"You little bastard, don't give me a playful smile. This time, for the sake of you bringing the medicine back, I won't care about you. If there is a next time, I will definitely break your legs." Yan Laoge warned.

"Uncle, smoke, smoke!"

Yan Yaozong chuckled and took out two packs of cigarettes, stuffed one pack into Yan Laoge's trouser pocket, and then

Yan Laoge laughed and cursed, but did not refuse.

While the two were chatting, fellow villagers rushed to the village committee one after another.

The villagers looked at Yan Yaozong who was standing next to Yan Laoge.

In the past, Yan Yaozong was just like a boring gourd.

But now, Yan Yaozong is chatting with the old village chief with a confident smile on his face.

"Yao Zong!"

Yan Zhendong ran into the office wearing a raincoat and walked to Yan Yaozong's side immediately.

After waiting for seven or eight minutes, the old village chief saw that people had almost arrived, so he said, "Folks, I'm calling you here this time, mainly to distribute some medicine to you... These medicines were brought back by Yaozong and Zhendong from the health station. So, you have to

“You also know about Yaozong’s situation.Therefore, I decided to temporarily lend Yaozong the small room on the second floor of the village committee to live in."
